title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro SR (Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres)
description:
SOBRE A CLI


Oferecemos serviços de alta qualidade de recepção, armazenagem e embarque de grãos e açúcar. Somos um operador independente de terminais servindo tradings e apoiando o agronegócio responsável no Brasil.

Estamos presentes em dois importantes portos - Itaqui e Santos - desempenhando um papel chave na conexão das regiões produtoras do Brasil ao mundo.


Se você quer servir ao agronegócio sustentável do Brasil, contribuindo para movimentar a riqueza do campo até a mesa das pessoas, candidate-se a uma de nossas oportunidades abertas. Temos operações no Porto de Santos (SP), no Porto de Itaqui (MA) e equipes administrativas em São Paulo, Capital.


O QUE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO?


Profissional com sólida experiência em FP&A, sendo responsável por gerar análises financeiras e projeções que suportem decisões estratégicas, assegurando a qualidade das informações de orçamento e forecast, contribuindo para a otimização de custos, melhoria da performance financeira e orientação de investimentos por meio de análises de viabilidade, risco e retorno.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis e áreas correlatadas.
  • Sólida experiência com planejamento e análises financeiras complexas e estratégicas.
  • Diferencial: conhecimento em SAP e Power BI e experiência com modelagem financeira.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Benefícios: Plano de saúde, plano odontológico, vale alimentação e/ou refeição, auxílio academia, auxílio farmácia, seguro de vida, PPR, convênios com instituições de ensino, programas de saúde e bem-estar, entre outros.
  • Nossa jornada de trabalho é no modelo híbrido, sendo 2 dias em casa e 3 dias no nosso escritório em Santos/SP.


Na CLI valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão em todos os nossos processos, não importando perfil ou característica de cor, origem, gênero ou orientação sexual.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Frontend
description:
Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Atue com autonomia, visão sistêmica e capacidade de abstração para estruturar problemas e orientar o time nas soluções;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source, sendo referência dentro e fora do time.


O que você vai fazer

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas como: migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads;
  • Ser protagonista na melhoria contínua da developer experience no repositório e incentivar o uso e contribuição por toda a companhia.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento sólido em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência prática com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Liberdade técnica para propor e conduzir melhorias estruturais;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .


Location: Brazil, Language: Portuguese


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School completed or pursuing Bachelors.
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.


If Interested, kindly send your resume at: .

O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente

title: Senior Angular Developer (Angular and Electron)
description:
At Intellias , we're always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our team in Colombia. Over 20 years of market experience, Intellias brings together technologists, creators and innovators in Europe, North and Latin America, and the Middle East. Join our international team and take the mission to solve the advanced tech challenges of tomorrow!


If you're enthusiastic about contributing your skills and experience to our organization, we invite you to submit your CV for this position.


What we offer you in Intellias

  • B2B Contract
  • Fixed hour-based salary. You should have a private entrepreneurs (PE) and open US dollar bank account.
  • Corporate courses (Udemy, LinkedIn Learning and O'Raily)
  • Technical equipment on request
  • 100% English environment


Requirements:


  • English B2/C1
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development
  • Highly Proficient in Angular 20, TypeScript, JavaScript, ES8+, HTML5, CSS3.
  • Proficient in test-driven development, automated testing, and the use of testing frameworks
  • Experience with Less/Sass CSS Pre-processors
  • Experience in the area of modular and scalable software development
  • Experience maintaining a living and complex codebase with a modern stack
  • Designing and developing reusable, testable front end components
  • Desire to learn cutting edge technology to solve complex business problems
  • Experience with Electron, Webpack, NodeJS, Vue.js, NPM, SVG


Responsabilities


  • Develop and maintain modern web solutions as a Senior Engineer within the Web Team using Angular 18, JavaScript, TypeScript (ES8+), HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable UI components for web and desktop platforms, including Web, Windows, and macOS applications.
  • Establish and uphold high‑quality, maintainable, and performant coding standards , ensuring consistency across multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA teams, and UX designers to deliver new features and enhancements for next‑generation applications.
  • Contribute to architecture design, technical decisions, design patterns, and development best practices .
  • Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing .
  • Drive continuous improvement in frontend architecture, performance, and user experience .
  • Own features from concept and design through implementation and delivery , ensuring alignment with both business and technical goals .

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

title: Especialista SAP S/4HANA
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar como ponto focal funcional de SAP FI e CO no projeto de migração para o S/4HANA.
  • Conduzir workshops de levantamento, análise e desenho de processos, assegurando alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio e as boas práticas SAP.
  • Definir, documentar e validar o blueprint funcional dos módulos de FI e CO, garantindo aderência à estratégia Clean Core.
  • Apoiar a equipe técnica em especificações funcionais detalhadas para desenvolvimento e interfaces.
  • Garantir Alinhamento com os Objetivos de Negócio (Projetos & Sustentação): Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os stakeholders.
  • Transformação Digital e Inovação: impulsionar a adoção de novas soluções tecnológicas SAP e modelos de operação digital. Promover automação e eficiência operacional.
  • Manutenção dos princípios Clean Core de desenvolvimento e da adoção dos conceitos standard SAP: Zelar e fomentar a manutenção dos princípios, governança e boas-práticas.
  • Suportar na correta operacionalização e evolução da solução SAP S/4HANA do Aché: Atuar como ´Advisor´ para times de projetos e operações de TI.
  • Apoiar o time de Arquitetura e Governança na documentação técnica e funcional conforme metodologia do projeto.
  • Participar ativamente das fases de testes integrados (SIT/UAT), suporte a cutover e hypercare.
  • Capacidade de conduzir projetos de implementação e melhorias contínuas nos módulos SAP FI/CO.
  • Garantir a integração contábil com módulos SAP relacionados (MM, SD, IM, PS).
  • Preparar e revisar especificações funcionais para desenvolvimentos ABAP.
  • Saber suportar processos de fechamento contábil e fiscal em conformidade com normas locais (IFRS, BRGAAP).
  • Conduzir treinamentos de key-users e transferências de conhecimento.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou MBA em Tecnologia, Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Empresarial, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência sólida em projetos SAP FI e CO, com participação end‑to‑end em implementações, desde a fase de desenho até o go‑live.
  • Experiência com projetos de implementação ou rollout de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio dos submódulos de FI (GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, New GL) e CO (Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Product Costing). CO: CO-PC (Custeio do Produto), CO-OM (Centros de Custo e Ordens Internas), CO-PA (Análise de Rentabilidade) e CO-PM/PS (Integração com manutenção e projetos) e Activity-Based Costing (ABC) (será diferencial).
  • Vivência com Fiori Apps, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) e mecanismos de reporting CO-PA será um diferencial.
  • Experiência em definição e validação de migração de dados (LSMW, BODS, Migration Cockpit).
  • Habilidade para entender as necessidades do negócio, levantar requisitos e traduzir em soluções funcionais de forma assertiva.
  • Imprescindível Certificação SAP nos módulos de sua frente de atuação.

title: Supervisor(a) de Customer Success
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia focada em proteção de marcas, monitoramento digital e compliance no ambiente online. Estamos em rápido crescimento e buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Customer Success para liderar a operação de atendimento B2B, garantindo excelência na experiência do cliente, retenção e expansão de receita.


O que você vai encontrar ao fazer parte da Branddi:

Startup em constante evolução: Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e crescer!

Ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor: Valorizamos e incentivamos novas ideias. Sua contribuição é essencial para nós!

Espaço para inovação: Buscamos sempre melhorar nossos processos e fluxos, e contamos com você para ajudar nesse processo de aprimoramento.

Integração entre áreas: Em nosso time, todos se conectam e colaboram, criando um ambiente dinâmico e alinhado.

Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de onde se sentir mais confortável com o nosso modelo de home-office.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar e desenvolver o time de Customer Success, acompanhando performance individual e coletiva, promovendo feedbacks constantes e fortalecendo uma cultura orientada a resultados.
  • Gestão da Carteira de Clientes: Garantir excelência no atendimento e relacionamento com clientes B2B, assegurando retenção, satisfação e identificação de oportunidades de expansão.
  • Gestão por Indicadores: Monitorar e evoluir KPIs estratégicos da área, como churn, expansão (upsell e cross-sell), NPS, tempo de resposta e engajamento da base.
  • Processos e Melhoria Contínua: Estruturar, revisar e otimizar fluxos e processos da área de Customer Success, garantindo eficiência, padronização e escalabilidade.

  • Vivência em liderança de times e acompanhamento de metas e indicadores.

  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Bônus mensal por resultados.

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.
  • Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment.
  • Domain Experience
  • Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents.
  • Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.
  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.
